source: hand-written stand-in (no API key where the suite was built); re-record with npm run evals -- --live --record
ask: Write a script that goes to the Congress layout, finds the House Republicans from Ohio and sorts them by district, highest first

input.text:
Go to Layout [ "Congress" ]
Enter Find Mode [ Pause: Off ]
Set Field [ Congress::Party ; "R" ]
Set Field [ Congress::Chamber ; "House" ]
Set Field [ Congress::State ; "Ohio" ]
Set Error Capture [ On ]
Perform Find [ ]
Sort Records [ Restore ; Congress::District ; descending ; With dialog: Off ]
input.summary: Find the Ohio House Republicans, sorted by district, highest first

content.text: Here is the script. Set Error Capture keeps a "no records match" dialog from stopping it if the data changes; the dry run on a copy found the members and sorted them by district, highest first.
